sentence: In this era of rapid technological advancement, novel inventions have profoundly transformed our daily lives. From traditional dialing to instant online messaging, smartphones have completely revolutionized the way people communicate. While some argue that these devices have reduced face-to-face interactions, others hold the opposite view. I personally believe that although modern technology connects us more efficiently, it can also lead to superficial relationships.

sentence:
The necessity of homework has long been a subject of debate. While some argue that after-school assignments are nonessential, others believe they play a crucial role in education. In my opinion, although excessive homework can be detrimental, a moderate amount is highly beneficial.





Homework is essential for children in helping them maintain a stable routine. First, after finishing a long day at school, children return home to a comfortable environment where they can further reinforce their learning. Developing such consistency fosters good study habits. Second, reviewing what they learned is crucial, as the learning process requires repetition to reinforce knowledge.





On the other hand, some argue that an excessive amount of homework deprives children of adequate rest. Nowadays, parents enroll their children in various extracurricular activities. Pursuits such as music lessons or competitive sports like soccer or swimming require significant time and dedication. Spending too much time on assignments severely disrupts their academics and personal lives. Moreover, forcing children to complete repetitive mechanical writing exercises stifles their natural creativity.





Therefore, a balanced approach is preferred; homework should be assigned selectively rather than being mandatory for every subject. By considering children's schedules, assignments should be arranged thoughtfully. Depending on the learning objectives of each subject, the quantity of homework ought to align with the most effective learning methods. Let’s build an inclusive and friendly learning environment for our future generations!

sentence: Living in a modern society, technology has facilitated seamless communication. First, technology effectively bridges geographical barriers; consequently, we can converse with others regardless of their physical location. Furthermore, instant messaging apps eliminate the constraints of time zones, allowing users to respond to messages immediately regardless of time differences. Thus, technological devices provide us with unparalleled opportunities to interact with anyone, anywhere.
